name: FFS_ACTIVITY_WORK_SKILL
description: Defines work skills required to complete particular activities.

columns.name: ARCH_DATE
columns.description: DB record partitioning date. Set automatically by DB Optimization job.

columns.name: ACTIVITY_ID
columns.description: Identifier of the activity the work skill is required for.

columns.name: WORK_SKILL_ID
columns.description: It is a reference to a work skill.

columns.name: REQUIRED_LEVEL
columns.description: It is a minimum allowed level of the skill required to complete this activity. (0 - this skill is optional).

columns.name: PREFERABLE_LEVEL
columns.description: It is a preferable level of the skill. It is an assignment goal.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.
